# Unit test for function select_words
def test_select_words():
    # Basic examples
    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 4) == ["little"]
    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 3) == ["Mary", "lamb"]
    assert select_words("simple white space", 2) == []
    assert select_words("Hello World", 4) == ["World"]
    assert select_words("Uncle sam", 3) == ["Uncle"]

    # Empty string
    assert select_words("", 3) == []
    assert select_words("", 0) == []

    # n = 0 selects words with only vowels
    assert select_words("a e i o u aeio", 0) == ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u", "aeio"]

    # Case insensitivity: uppercase consonants still count
    assert select_words("AEIOU BCDF", 4) == ["BCDF"]
    assert select_words("Apple ORANGE", 3) == ["Apple"]

    # Single word strings
    assert select_words("hello", 3) == ["hello"]
    assert select_words("hello", 2) == []

    # Words with mixed case
    assert select_words("AbCdEf", 3) == ["AbCdEf"]

    # Multiple matches preserving order
    assert select_words("cat dog bird fish", 2) == ["cat", "dog", "fish"]

    # No matches
    assert select_words("one two three", 10) == []

    # Repeated identical words
    assert select_words("test test test", 3) == ["test", "test", "test"]

    # Extra whitespace between words
    assert select_words("  Mary   had  a  little   lamb ", 4) == ["little"]

def test_select_words():

    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 4) == ["little"]
    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 3) == ["Mary", "lamb"]
    assert select_words("simple white space", 2) == []
    assert select_words("Hello world", 4) == ["world"]
    assert select_words("Uncle sam", 3) == ["Uncle"]

    # Empty string
    assert select_words("", 0) == []
    assert select_words("", 4) == []

    # Single-character words
    assert select_words("a b c d", 1) == ["b", "c", "d"]
    assert select_words("a e i o u", 0) == ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u"]

    # Case-insensitivity of vowel detection
    assert select_words("AEIOU aeiou", 0) == ["AEIOU", "aeiou"]
    assert select_words("BCDF bcdf", 4) == ["BCDF", "bcdf"]

    # All words match
    assert select_words("cat dog fox", 2) == ["cat", "dog", "fox"]

    # No matches
    assert select_words("cat dog fox", 5) == []

    # Repeated words
    assert select_words("hello hello world", 3) == ["hello", "hello"]

    # Words with all consonants vs all vowels
    assert select_words("rhythm sky eye", 3) == ["sky"]
    assert select_words("rhythm", 5) == ["rhythm"]
